page.title: Settings
page.subtitle: Manage your business and system configuration

business.title: Business Details
business.description: Saved to your company profile — shown on receipts and reports
business.name: Business Name
business.receiptHeaderPlaceholder: e.g. Thank you for shopping with us!
business.receiptFooterPlaceholder: e.g. Goods sold are not returnable.

language.title: Language
language.defaultLocaleHelp: Staff who have not picked a language see Balce in this one.
language.receiptLanguageHelp: Used on printed and on-screen receipts.
language.personalChoice: Each person can still pick their own language from the language button in the header.

system.currencyDescription: Applied to all sales and reports
system.formatDescription: Controls how dates and receipt numbers are displayed
system.taxRateHelpRegistered: Charged at the till because the business is registered for VAT.
system.taxRateHelpNotRegistered: Not charged at the till: the business is not registered for VAT. Turn it on in Settings → Features if TRA registered you.

hardware.tillDescription: Only switch on what your tills use. Everything off stays hidden at the till.
hardware.numpadHelp: For touch screens: type quantities and cash without a keyboard
hardware.customerDisplayHelp: A second screen facing the customer shows the items, total and change
hardware.receiptDescription: Apply to printed and on-screen receipts
hardware.autoPrintHelp: No prompt — prints immediately on completion
hardware.showTaxHelp: Display VAT as a separate line item
hardware.barcodesHelp: Include product barcodes below line items
hardware.printerDescription: Connect a USB or network thermal printer
hardware.noPrinters: No USB or serial printer detected. Plug it in and click Refresh, or type its port below.

efd.title: Electronic Fiscal Device
efd.description: Send every sale to your EFD service after it is saved
efd.apiKeySavedPlaceholder: Saved. Type a new key to replace it
efd.offHelp: When on, each sale is sent to the EFD address below. Selling keeps working if the EFD is offline; waiting receipts can be sent again from Sales History.

notifications.soundDescription: Play a sound when stock alerts are triggered in-app
notifications.stockDescription: Notifications when inventory reaches critical levels
notifications.lowStockHelp: Triggers when quantity falls below the threshold
notifications.outOfStockHelp: Triggers when a product reaches zero units
notifications.deadStockHelp: Items with no sales movement over a set period
notifications.emailDescription: Receive stock alerts by email in addition to in-app

branding.colorDescription: Used for buttons, highlights and charts in both light and dark mode.
branding.weakContrast: This colour blends into the page background (contrast {ratio}:1, aim for at least 3:1), so outlines, focus rings and chart lines will be hard to see. A stronger shade works better.
branding.logoDescription: Shown in the header and on receipts.
branding.logoHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP · up to 1 MB

network.title: Let other devices on this network use Balce
network.description: Other tills, tablets and phones on the same Wi-Fi open Balce in their browser. This computer keeps the data, so leave it switched on while the shop is open.
network.addressFixed: The address is fixed by the LISTEN_ADDR setting on this computer, so this switch is off.
network.openAddress: Open this address on the other device, or scan the code with its camera:
network.notConnected: This computer isn't connected to a network right now. Connect it to the shop Wi-Fi and the address will show here.
network.offHelp: Off: only this computer can use Balce. Nothing is reachable from the network.
network.firewallBefore: When Windows asks about the firewall, allow
network.routerBefore: Ask whoever set up the router to
network.bookmarkStep: On each till, open the address above in Chrome or Edge and bookmark it. "Install app" in the browser menu gives it its own window.
network.cashierStep: Each cashier signs in with their own account. Receipts print from that till's own printer through the browser.
network.securityNote: Only people with a Balce account can sign in. Switch this off when the shop is closed if the Wi-Fi is shared with customers.
network.phonePhotosNote: Phone photos for products also need this switched on, so the phone can reach this computer.

toasts.couldNotOpen: This computer could not open the network address. It stays on this computer only.
toasts.enabled: Other devices can now open Balce
toasts.disabled: Balce is back to this computer only
toasts.changeFailed: The network setting could not be changed

toasts.logoTooLarge: The logo must be 1 MB or smaller

buying.title: Buying stock
buying.description: Turn on only what your shop uses. Everything works without these.
buying.suppliersHelp: Keep a list of the people you buy from and record the stock they deliver. Off: just add stock as today.
buying.purchaseOrdersHelp: Write down what you ordered from a supplier and tick it off when it arrives.

selling.title: Customers and credit
selling.description: Most sales stay anonymous. Turn these on when you need to know who bought.
selling.customersHelp: Save customers with a name and phone number and see what they bought.
selling.creditHelp: Let a customer pay later. Balce keeps what each one owes and reminds you.
selling.ordersHelp: Take an order with a deposit, keep the stock aside, and finish the sale when they collect.

accounting.title: Accounting
accounting.description: Balce keeps the books from your sales and stock. You only record the money that goes out.
accounting.offHelp: No books. Sales and reports work as they do now.
accounting.simpleHelp: Record money out, money you put in or take out, and see profit, what you own and what you owe.
accounting.fullHelp: For an accountant: chart of accounts, adjustments, month-end closing, trial balance and balance sheet.

vat.help: Only if TRA registered your business for VAT. Balce then shows VAT on purchases and what to pay each month.
vat.numberRequired: Enter the VRN to turn VAT on.
